career_ladder.note: Career progression outlined for engineering and technical cadres recruited via Combined Technical Services (such as Junior Draughting Officer and Assistant Engineer in Public Works Department, Highways Department, and Rural Development). Direct recruitment occurs at both Diploma (Level 11) and Degree (Level 16/20) tiers.

steps.years: approx. 5-10 yrs (or direct entry for Degree holders)

exam_scheme.note: Combined Technical Services Examination features a unified examination structure across diploma and degree recruitments: Paper I (OMR objective test covering Tamil eligibility and General Studies) and Paper II (Computer-Based Test in the relevant engineering or technical subject). For interview posts, a 60-mark viva-voce is added.

stages.stage_name: Paper I — Tamil Eligibility & General Studies (Objective Type - OMR Method)
stages.source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 11/2024, Section 6.1: Scheme of Examination (Paper I)

papers.paper_name: Part A — Tamil Eligibility Test (SSLC Standard, 100 Qs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (60 marks) required for evaluation of Part B and Paper II; marks not added to ranking

papers.paper_name: Part B — General Studies (75 Qs) & Aptitude and Mental Ability Test (25 Qs)

stages.stage_name: Paper II — Technical Subject Paper (Computer Based Test - CBT)
stages.source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 11/2024, Section 6.1: Scheme of Examination (Paper II Subject Paper)

papers.paper_name: Technical Discipline Subject Paper (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Architecture / Surveying / etc. at Diploma or Degree standard, 200 Qs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined minimum qualifying marks (Part B of Paper I + Paper II): 135 marks (SCs, STs, MBCs, BCs) / 180 marks (Others)

financial_package.note: Salaries for Technical Services personnel are established under the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Rules 2017. Junior Draughting Officers and Draughtsmen enter at Level 11 (₹35,400 - ₹1,30,400), while degree-level Assistant Engineers enter at Level 16 (₹36,400 - ₹1,34,200) or Level 20.
financial_package.pay_source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 11/2024, Section 3: Posts and Vacancies (Level 11, Rs. 35,400 - 1,30,400 under TN Revised Pay Matrix)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate assumes Level 11 entry basic pay ₹35,400 at 58% DA plus Tamil Nadu Grade-classified HRA (approx. ₹3,000 - ₹5,000) and City Compensatory Allowance. Deductions include CPS (10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) comprehensive medical coverage for state employees and dependents
Field inspection and conveyance allowances for site engineers (PWD, Highways, TWAD)
Government quarters or standard Grade HRA according to posting district
Special technical allowance / equipment handling allowance where applicable
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual Pongal festive advance

competition_benchmarks.note: The Combined Technical Services Examination was introduced by TNPSC to streamline multiple departmental engineering and technical recruitments into unified diploma-level and degree-level cycles.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 126 (calculated: applicants ÷ total combined technical vacancies)
